candidates.exact_span: Unless otherwise indicated in this permit, if the EPA Region 6 MQL for a pollutant or pollutant parameter is sufficiently sensitive (as defined above) and the analytical test result is less than the MQL, then a value of zero (0) may be used for reporting purposes on DMRs.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This rule governs when sub-MQL analytical results may be reported as zero on DMRs. A different reading of 'sufficiently sensitive (as defined above)', whether a permit-specific override applies ('Unless otherwise indicated'), or whether the result is truly below the MQL could change the numeric value used for Purpose A limit comparisons and whether Purpose C treats the period as having an ordinary reported result versus a documented no-data or below-detection state.

candidates.exact_span: Furthermore, if the EPA Region 6 MQL for a pollutant or parameter is not sufficiently sensitive, but the analytical test result is less than the published ML from a sufficiently sensitive method, then a value of zero (0) may be used for reporting purposes on DMRs.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This alternate branch applies when the Region 6 MQL is not sufficiently sensitive but a published ML from another sufficiently sensitive method is met. Interpreting which MQL/ML applies, whether the method is 'sufficiently sensitive', or whether zero reporting is permitted could change the reported numeric value compared against limits (Purpose A) and whether missing-evidence semantics classify the result as reported zero, conditional non-requirement, or unresolved (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span: B. 24-HOUR ORAL REPORTING: DAILY MAXIMUM LIMITATION VIOLATIONS
candidates.computation_change_reason: The heading identifies a time-bounded oral reporting obligation tied specifically to daily maximum limitation violations. Interpreting whether a given exceedance is a 'daily maximum limitation violation' and whether the 24-hour reporting window applies could change which reporting obligations are established as required versus not required or unresolved under Purpose B.

candidates.exact_span: Under the provisions of Part III.D.7.b.(3) of this permit, violations of daily maximum limitations for the following pollutants shall be reported orally to EPA Region 6, Compliance and Assurance Division, Water Enforcement Branch (6EN-W), Dallas, Texas, and concurrently to NMED
candidates.computation_change_reason: This clause links oral reporting to violations of daily maximum limitations for specified pollutants and incorporates conditions from Part III.D.7.b.(3). Different interpretations of that cross-referenced provision, which pollutants are in scope ('the following pollutants'), or whether a measured exceedance constitutes a daily maximum violation could change Purpose A violation findings and Purpose B determinations of whether oral reporting was required, not required, or unresolved.
